current_claim: A released source-ledgered research and demonstrator package with claim genealogy, contradiction register, decision records, and checksums.
mechanism: Claim, source, contradiction, model-revision, and decision records constrain a public demonstrator and its admissible statements.

findings.title: The release package has strong ledgers but no estate-standard replay receipt tying every public interaction to the exact claim row it renders.
findings.mechanism: CSV and JSON records can be internally disciplined while the demonstrator silently summarizes, filters, or labels them beyond the registered claim force.
findings.acceptance: Browser playtests must trace every rendered claim, qualifier, contradiction, and decision to an immutable row and source receipt.

findings.title: Source freshness and retrieval custody are frozen at a dated verification snapshot.
findings.mechanism: A verified 2026-07-26 ledger does not itself reveal later source mutation, link death, replacement, or licensing change.
findings.acceptance: Add a revalidation adapter that preserves old source states, records current availability, and never rewrites the frozen release.

findings.title: Design, compact-width, accessibility, and failure-state evidence are not release-class artifacts.
findings.mechanism: Checksums protect bytes, not perceptual hierarchy or usable interaction.
findings.acceptance: Cut a successor demonstrator release with visual goldens, semantic navigation, keyboard and touch evidence, and explicit unsupported-source states.

next_gate: Bind the demonstrator to the claim ledger at runtime and revalidate sources without mutating the frozen release.
